verdict.rationale: Render documents managed full-stack deployment: push-to-deploy from a repo, Docker support, fully-managed databases, load-based autoscaling, and a global CDN for static assets. It does not document request-serving serverless functions. The closest feature is the Workflows SDK, which registers functions as background tasks rather than HTTP/edge functions. Missing for 10: documented serverless/edge function runtime, explicit 'no servers to manage' function model, independent corroboration of the serverless side.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Connect your repo and ship with every push.
Deploy fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas, and high availability.
Deploy reliable agents and background processes at scale, without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic.
Load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond
Use `task()` to register a provided function (`func`) as a workflow task with the specified `options`.
